target: conditional difference theta_desk minus theta_poster in seven-day self-reports for comparable fictional volunteers
observation_unit: one fictional convenience volunteer; one recruitment route; one seven-day binary self-report
primary_prior: independent Beta(1,1) for both route probabilities
sensitivity_prior: independent Beta(2,2) for both route probabilities
likelihood: within-route independent Bernoulli reports conditional on route-specific probability
method_choice: counts describe the authored file; a disclosed exact Beta model can answer conditional probability questions; an intervention effect requires a better comparison design
illustrative_magnitude: 0.10 probability-scale difference is a learning threshold, not a validated benefit
scope: fictional convenience volunteers; conditional route association, no causal effect or campus rate; prior and posterior predictive checks are in-sample; no MCMC
report_status: reproducible teaching report, not a pre-registered real study or release manuscript
